page.layout: Running head top centre; page number top right; one column of text with a title block and two poems; a few stray marks in the margins, no printed marginal notes.

main_text.l: Vm Masuri, grande ore tonas Babylona ru-
Cantata est quanta Troia nec ipsa tuba:
Est quod Maonides, est quod tibi maior & ipso
Error in hoc tamen est, Masuri, quod carmine
HEnrici iugulum Regis, quo Gallia rege
Auersans scelus hoc tantum, qui celsus ab alto
Fata hominum iusta cum ratione regit.
Henrici a iugulo, gladium convertit in ora:
Captro impar, sed enim sic quoque grande

page.notes: The title block is set in large capitals; the first poem and the second poem are separated by a rule. The first word of the second poem carries a large initial. Some words in the first poem are italic; the Latin is partly damaged at the line ends, and words such as "Masuri", "Maonides" and "Captro" are doubtful. Stray ink marks appear in the margins and are not transcribed.
